understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete KA59 by solving each level: place every selectable piece onto goal tiles marked '+' so that all goals are occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN, then continue until all levels are cleared.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each level is a 3-pixels-per-cell grid where the currently selected piece (P) moves with MOVE_* actions by attempting to shift one cell in that direction; movement can be blocked by walls/bounds or other objects, though the movement_blocked flags are only hints and not guarantees. Pushable blocks can be moved if they are adjacent in the direction of travel, shifting along with the selected piece when pushed. Levels may contain multiple selectables (S); control switches via CLICK on the exact pixel-coordinate position of another selectable as listed in the state, and winning requires coordinating multiple pieces so all '+' tiles are covered at once within the step budget.
